skill.summary: create text prompt into AI-generated videos with this skill. Works with TXT, DOCX, PDF, copied text files up to 500MB. marketers use it for generating videos...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: generate videos from text prompts with cloud-based AI video creation.

- Converts text (TXT, DOCX, PDF, or pasted) to 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB; accepts a wide range of file types (video, image, audio, document).
- Automatic backend connection and session management on first use.
- Free tier: 100 credits, valid for 7 days without registration.
- Exposes workflows for video generation, uploading, credits, status, and export.
- All operations run remotely; no local installation required.
